title: Composed input-seeking machine
statement: There is a deterministic Turing machine with two work tapes and Boolean symbols. Its state set is the disjoint union of the sweep phases, the four input-rewind states, the counter-loop states with unit body state, and another copy of the sweep phases; its transition function is the composition of the two-tape copy machine, the input-seeking-and-rewind machine, the counter loop driven by the one-step input-seek machine, and the tape-clearing machine, joined using the specified exit states.
caveat: The component machine definitions and the semantics of `seamCompTM` are absent, so the composed machine's operational behavior cannot be rendered more explicitly from this snippet.
